text: OAuth · 账号登录条是一款面向 DSH 桌面端的账号管理插件，在会话输入区下方显示 Grok/xAI 与 ChatGPT Codex 的登录状态。它通过 DSH Host 提供设备 OAuth 登录、取消、换号、刷新和退出操作，并按当前会话的模型选择账号；登录后可补齐缺失的模型路由。用户可查看授权链接与设备码、账号状态和操作结果。适合在 DSH 桌面工作流中管理这两类官方 OAuth 账号；需要对应服务账号及 DSH 的授权与凭据服务。

OAuth · Account Login Strip is a DSH desktop plugin that shows Grok/xAI and ChatGPT Codex login status below the conversation composer. Through DSH Host services it supports official OAuth device login, cancellation, account switching, refresh, and logout, and chooses the account from the current。

OAuth · 账号登录条的功能「设备登录」：从会话输入区启动 Grok 或 GPT 的官方 OAuth 设备流程，并显示授权链接和设备码；官方授权服务负责轮询与凭据提交。
OAuth · 账号登录条的功能「账号切换与会话状态」：根据当前会话模型选择显示对应提供方和账号状态；发起操作前后核对选择，切换到其他提供方时取消未完成授权。
OAuth · 账号登录条的功能「刷新登录」：对当前提供方的 OAuth 凭据执行刷新，验证刷新后的授权，并在缺少模型路由时尝试补上。
OAuth · 账号登录条的功能「退出账号」：尝试向提供方吊销授权，再删除 DSH Host 中对应的本地凭据；界面可收到远端吊销失败信息。
OAuth · 账号登录条会向 xAI 与 OpenAI 的认证端点发送刷新或吊销请求，并向模型目录服务验证授权；Grok 账号显示名称还可能从身份接口查询。

核心能力 · 工作方式 · 快速开始 · 账号与配置 · 验证

OAuth README · Introduction：---

针对个人 DSH 桌面工作流的参考实现。输入框下方显示 Grok / GPT 状态，授权由官方已注册的 flow 完成，token 只留在 Host。请先核对自己的 DSH 版本与提供方权限，不直接照搬个人配置。

OAuth README · 核心能力：
🔑 官方设备登录

展示官方 notice 链接和设备码，调用 authorization.begin，不自行重写轮询或 PKCE。		 🔄 换号与续期

换号先取消旧授权并等待 settled；手动刷新在官方凭据锁内执行。		 🧭 会话感知状态

跟随官方模型投影，切换会话/模型清除旧账号，不为读历史恢复 Agent。
🧩 补齐缺失路由

沿用官方模型目录，保留已有列表和配置，用版本号处理并发修改。		 🛡 Host 内凭据

不把 token 写入 Client 或对话，也不读取其他 CLI 的 auth.json。		 🧾 明确操作结果

区分本地退出与远端吊销失败；凭据成功保存不冒充路由配置也成功。
OAuth README · 工作方式：使用官方 `authorization.begin({key, method: "oauth", interaction, signal})`，由 `llm-pi-ai` flow 负责设备码、轮询、PKCE、期限及提交。正常续期由官方适配器负责；本插件不另存认证副本。

OAuth README · 快速开始：需要官方 DSH 桌面版及对应 Grok / ChatGPT Codex 账号权限。原适配面向 Grok/SuperGrok/X Premium 与 ChatGPT Plus/Pro Codex；最终以官方接口实际接受的账号为准。

```sh
export DSH_HOME="${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}"
git clone https://github.com/yueyexiayu/dsh-OAuth.git "$DSH_HOME/plugins/OAuth"
```

将下项合并到 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`，保留其他插件；`OAuth` 大小写一致：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: OAuth
      name: ../../plugins/OAuth/lib/index.js
```
OAuth README · 快速开始：**⌘Q 完全退出 DSH 后重开**，在输入框下方选择对应登录按钮，按官方 notice 完成设备授权。不使用 CLI 插件管理改 desktop profile，不需要重建官方桌面包。

OAuth README · 账号与配置：| 项目 | 行为 | | --- | --- | | 存储 | Host 的 `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`，键为 `llm-pi-ai/xai`、`llm-pi-ai/openai-codex` | | 会话选择 | 官方只读 `sessionQuery.observeSession`，`modelSelection.next ?? lastUsed` | | 默认模型 | 仅无sessionId新入口，或已确认存在但无模型选择的空会话采用 | | API Key 路由 | 明示退出 OAuth 不改变该认证，不擅自切换方式 | | 路由补全 | 官方 `settings.describe/mutate`，保留已有路由/模型，版本冲突重查 |
取消、竞态与失败语义

OAuth README · 账号与配置：- 换号/退出先取消同凭据key的授权并等待官方 `authorization/settled`，再启动新授权或删除凭据。卸载、取消和会话切换到其他提供方中止本插件发起的flow；不保证任意忽略取消的第三方实现。
- 无效sessionId返回400，不存在404，模型/账号不匹配或已切换409。历史读取、格式、投影及持久化异常明确失败，不回落无关全球账号。
- Client 订阅模型投影，Host 异步完成后再次核对归属，旧请求不覆盖新状态。后台查询不清除操作错误。
- 刷新需合法 access token；缺少有效期采用官方默认，给出时须有限正数。省略 refresh token 保留旧值；字段存在但无效时拒绝并保留旧凭据。已完成轮换的有效凭据不会因后续配置失败或卸载丢弃。
- 远端不支持吊销时明确报失败；本地凭据仍删除，分别显示结果。不支持的交互prompt与授权/提交失败直接显示，不假装成功。
- 已知凭据在错误中脱敏，不声称识别任意未知opaque token。不读取或改写 `~/.grok/auth.json` / `~/.codex/auth.json`，仓库不含账号凭据。

OAuth README · 验证：```sh
cd "$DSH_HOME/plugins/OAuth"
for file in lib/*.js scripts/*.mjs test/*.mjs; do node --check "$file" || exit 1; done
node --test
```

可选官方组件验证：

```sh
DSH_OFFICIAL_NODE_MODULES=/absolute/path/to/official/node_modules node --test scripts/verify-official.mjs
```

OAuth README · Introduction：

OAuth · Account login strip

Manage Grok and GPT beside the composer, without copying authentication protocols.

Official OAuth device login, account switching and logout for DeepSeek Harness desktop.

简体中文 · English

v0.1.3 · MIT · DSH desktop plugin

Features · How it works · Quick start · Accounts and configuration · Validation

OAuth README · Introduction：---

A reference for a personal DSH desktop workflow. Grok/GPT status appears below the composer; registered official flows perform authorization and tokens stay in the Host. Verify your DSH version and provider entitlement rather than copying personal settings unchanged.

OAuth README · Features：
🔑 Official device login

Show the official notice URL/code and call authorization.begin, rather than reimplement polling or PKCE.		 🔄 Switching and renewal

Cancel and await settled authorization before switching; manual refresh uses the official credential lock.		 🧭 Session-aware status

Follow official model projections, clear stale account state and inspect history without resuming an Agent.
🧩 Missing-route setup

Inherit the official model catalog, retain existing configuration and use versioned concurrent writes.		 🛡 Host credentials

No tokens in the Client or conversation and no access to other CLI auth.json files.		 🧾 Explicit outcomes

Distinguish local logout from failed remote revocation, and saved credentials from failed route configuration.

OAuth README · How it works：Calls official `authorization.begin({key, method: "oauth", interaction, signal})`. Registered `llm-pi-ai` flows own device codes, polling, PKCE, expiry and persistence. Official adapters handle normal renewal; the plugin stores no parallel credential copy.

OAuth README · Quick start：Requires official DSH desktop and appropriate Grok/ChatGPT Codex account access. The original integration targets Grok/SuperGrok/X Premium and ChatGPT Plus/Pro Codex; actual provider acceptance determines availability.

```sh
export DSH_HOME="${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}"
git clone https://github.com/yueyexiayu/dsh-OAuth.git "$DSH_HOME/plugins/OAuth"
```

Merge into `$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`, preserving other entries and the case-sensitive `OAuth` name:

OAuth README · Quick start：```yaml
- insert:
    - id: OAuth
      name: ../../plugins/OAuth/lib/index.js
```

**Quit DSH fully with ⌘Q and reopen it.** Choose the provider button below the composer and follow its official device notice. Do not use CLI plugin management to alter the desktop profile; no official desktop rebuild is required.

OAuth README · Accounts and configuration：| Item | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Storage | Host `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`: `llm-pi-ai/xai`, `llm-pi-ai/openai-codex` |
| Session selection | Official read-only `sessionQuery.observeSession`, `modelSelection.next ?? lastUsed` |
| Default model | Only an entry without sessionId or a confirmed existing empty session with no model selection |
| API Key routes | Explicitly state that OAuth logout does not change that authentication method |
| Route setup | Official `settings.describe/mutate`, preserving existing models/routes and rechecking version conflicts |

OAuth README · Accounts and configuration：
Cancellation, races and failure semantics

OAuth README · Accounts and configuration：- Switching/logout first cancels the credential key's flow and awaits `authorization/settled`, then starts another flow or removes credentials. Unload, cancel and provider changes stop flows initiated here; arbitrary third-party flows ignoring cancellation cannot be guaranteed.
- Invalid sessionId returns 400; nonexistent sessions 404; changed/mismatched model or account 409. History, format, projection and persistence errors fail explicitly, without querying an unrelated global account.
- The Client subscribes to model projections; the Host rechecks ownership after async work. Late responses cannot replace new state, and background queries do not erase operation errors.
- Refresh requires valid access tokens. Missing expiry uses the official default; provided expiry must be finite/positive. Omitted refresh tokens retain the old value; present invalid ones fail without replacing credentials. A valid completed rotation survives later configuration failure or unload.
- Unsupported remote revocation is an explicit failure; local credentials are still removed and both outcomes are reported. Unsupported prompts and authorization/persistence erro
